title: 字母大小写全排列
summary: 给定由字母和数字组成的字符串，返回切换任意字母大小写得到的所有字符串。
insight: 数字只有一个分支，字母有小写和大写两个分支；按位置 DFS 即可枚举完整笛卡尔积。
pitfalls: 每条路径结束时要复制当前字符数组
固定先小写后大写可得到稳定输出顺序

solutions.title: 逐字符大小写回溯
solutions.idea: 字母创建两个分支，数字直接前进。
steps: 把字符串转为字符数组
若当前是字母，依次设为小写、递归，再设为大写、递归；数字只递归一次
到达末尾把当前字符串加入答案

code.java: class Solution { public List<String> letterCasePermutation(String s){List<String> answer=new ArrayList<>();dfs(s.toCharArray(),0,answer);return answer;}private void dfs(char[] chars,int index,List<String> answer){if(index==chars.length){answer.add(new String(chars));return;}if(Character.isLetter(chars[index])){chars[index]=Character.toLowerCase(chars[index]);dfs(chars,index+1,answer);chars[index]=Character.toUpperCase(chars[index]);dfs(chars,index+1,answer);}else dfs(chars,index+1,answer);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun letterCasePermutation(s:String):List<String>{val answer=mutableListOf<String>();dfs(s.toCharArray(),0,answer);return answer};private fun dfs(chars:CharArray,index:Int,answer:MutableList<String>){if(index==chars.size){answer.add(String(chars));return};if(chars[index].isLetter()){chars[index]=chars[index].lowercaseChar();dfs(chars,index+1,answer);chars[index]=chars[index].uppercaseChar();dfs(chars,index+1,answer)}else dfs(chars,index+1,answer)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { void dfs(string& s,int index,vector<string>& answer){if(index==(int)s.size()){answer.push_back(s);return;}if(isalpha(s[index])){s[index]=tolower(s[index]);dfs(s,index+1,answer);s[index]=toupper(s[index]);dfs(s,index+1,answer);}else dfs(s,index+1,answer);}public:vector<string> letterCasePermutation(string s){vector<string> answer;dfs(s,0,answer);return answer;} };
